profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Team Lead | Distributed Architect | Building Scalable Web Applications & Cloud Services at RealPage (Stratis / Smart Access)
profile.summary:
I'm a Senior Software Engineer and Team Lead with 8 years of experience building web applications and distributed cloud services.
 
At RealPage, I design and deliver features and integrations for our smart building cloud platform, helping users manage services through web and mobile applications. I also serve as Distributed Architect, collaborating with senior engineers on cloud architecture, software design practices, and replatforming efforts for a mix of monolithic and microservices-based systems.
 
I enjoy leading small teams, making practical technical decisions on scalability and maintainability, mentoring other engineers, and tackling complex distributed systems challenges.
